text: Armed school police guards have been proven to prevent school shootings.

room.label: U.S. adults
room.source: KFF Health Misinformation Tracking Poll Pilot
room.note: 18% definitely true, 42% probably true; the false share is the published remainder. KFF offered definitely/probably true and probably/definitely false; the small remainder gave no answer.

truthSource.label: JAMA Network Open (2021)
truthSource.oneLine: A study of 133 school shootings from 1980 to 2019 found armed officers on site were not associated with fewer deaths; nothing has proven they prevent shootings.
